mapper.sql: c.course_id, c.course_name, c.course_code, c.credits, c.hours, c.teacher_id, u.real_name AS teacher_name, c.semester_id, s.semester_name AS semester_name, c.create_time, STUFF((SELECT ',' + CAST(cc.class_id AS VARCHAR(20)) FROM sys_course_class cc WHERE cc.course_id = c.course_id FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS class_ids, STUFF((SELECT ',' + cl.class_name FROM sys_course_class cc LEFT JOIN sys_class cl ON cc.class_id = cl.class_id WHERE cc.course_id = c.course_id FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS class_names
FROM sys_course c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.teacher_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_semester s ON c.semester_id = s.semester_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
INNER JOIN sys_course_class cc ON c.course_id = cc.course_id WHERE cc.class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_course (course_name, course_code, credits, hours, teacher_id, semester_id, create_time) VALUES (#{courseName}, #{courseCode}, #{credits}, #{hours}, #{teacherId}, #{semesterId}, SYSUTCDATETIME())
